question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic:**

**The first and Second alphabet are opposite to each other.**

**Second alphabet - 3 = Third alphabet.**

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **EVS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ab291dac1c519e20456658d9a686696dd5201a3ee2804bcf625137494a16b84.png] 

**Option 2) **IRP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a03524e467f2a3562920d1ad5668ef00dfa83104aaaed41a7ca55b07938579b4.png] 

**Option 3) **VEB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d779aa643f14209c9d54c0c861c98db3e0150bc6fb805a0758c7f4dd8afb727e.png] 

**Option 4) **GTQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/106c9fa37d5b0ecdeb5affff7d61f9c52849c5651ca70b0a3cfb13cc1425ca02.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IRP".**
